purpose: Teach: ミッキー/ウィリアムズ/クック/ヘレン/ダビデ/ケイト/トミー/メリー

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがディズニーランドでミッキーと写真撮って下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad took a photo with Mickey at Disneyland.
lines.style: Warm observation, speaking as if relaying something delightful. Gentle and unhurried. A small smile in the voice — pleased to share this moment with him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとテニスのウィリアムズ姉妹の試合観たよ
lines.en: Mom, I watched the Williams sisters' tennis match with Dad.
lines.style: Bright and direct, words tumbling out with genuine excitement. Quick pace, unstudied. The natural eagerness of a child sharing something that felt important.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが探検家ジェームズ・クックのドキュメンタリー観てらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad is watching a documentary about the explorer James Cook.
lines.style: Calm, observant tone. Speaking as though noticing something quietly interesting about her husband. Unhurried, matter-of-fact warmth. A slight pause before the name, like letting it land.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとヘレン・ケラーの映画観たよ
lines.en: Mom, I watched a film about Helen Keller with Dad.
lines.style: Same bright urgency as before but with a touch more pride. Eager to report another shared moment. Quick, genuine, no performance — just a child wanting her to know.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがダビデ像の解説本を読んでらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad is reading an art book about Michelangelo's David.
lines.style: Same gentle observational tone. Speaking with quiet affection about what her husband is absorbed in. Soft and steady, like she's noting small pieces of his day.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと英王室のケイト妃のニュース観たよ
lines.en: Mom, I watched the news about Kate, the Princess of Wales, with Dad.
lines.style: Bright and direct again, same infectious energy as his other reports. Words come easily. Proud to have shared this grown-up moment with his father.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがトミー・ヒルフィガーのお洋服を着てらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad is wearing a Tommy Hilfiger shirt.
lines.style: Observant, slightly amused fondness in the voice. A quiet noticing of something small about her husband. Spoken without emphasis — just a detail worth mentioning, like she's thinking out loud with affection.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとメリー・ポピンズのDVD観たよ
lines.en: Mom, I watched Mary Poppins on DVD with Dad.
lines.style: Bright burst of excitement, words spilling naturally. Final report of the day — warm and complete. A touch of satisfaction that he's shared something so treasured with his father.
